payload.title: The grammar-owner call in plan_convergence._valid_evidence_ref decides nothing: _valid_repo_path accepts any string that is not absolute or `..`-escaping, so every id parse_finding_id accepts is already a valid repo path
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach: if the upstream were correct would this code need to exist; a call that cannot change the result is dead code or the check is missing
payload.notes: Close condition: _valid_evidence_ref says what an evidence reference is in a way the id branch can change (a ref shaped like a finding id must be a valid id, so `ARIA-HIGH-0999` is refused) or the branch is removed and the reader of the function is told a ref is a repo path. A test pins `ARIA-HIGH-0999` and `ARIA-HIGH-1000`.
